author: 3snX
content:
Plan: Implement M11 worldbuilding browser UI in these components, committed separately:
1. worldbuildingStore.ts - Zustand store for browser state
2. etymology.ts - sound-change trace utility
3. HistoryTimeline.tsx - timeline with scrub + filters
4. PolityBrowser.tsx - polity list/detail
5. ReligionInspector.tsx - pantheon/rituals/holy sites
6. CultureInspector.tsx - feature vectors/language/economic base
7. SettlementDetail.tsx - settlement info with etymology
8. WorldbuildingBrowser.tsx - container with tabs + cross-linking
9. Wire into App.tsx
10. Tests
